CLASS_FUNCTION_CONTRACTS.PURPOSE: Define proposed class and function contracts for Issue #36 from the pinned source-code audit, MC36-002 module semantics, and Project Owner-approved decisions represented by proposed TECH36-002 and DP36-003. Those exact artifact revisions remain PROPOSED/PENDING; this CFC revision does not claim Human Approval or runtime interoperability.

NORMATIVE_BOUNDARIES.RULE: RequirementsAnalysis.xml and Contracts.xml remain unchanged. TECH36-002 and DP36-003 encode the Project Owner-approved decisions for OPEN-004, OPEN-009, OPEN-010 and OPEN-011, but these artifact revisions remain PROPOSED/PENDING until their own gates pass. MC36-002 remains the pinned module/inter-module baseline.
Historical FC32-* and CC32-* contracts are not approval for Issue 36 and are not copied as target contracts.
All proposed symbols and the durable delivery-outbox design are design-only. This artifact does not authorize production code, migrations, tests, deployment, merge, or release.

No HTTP path or method is assigned for UnifiedPush registration or wakeToken resolution because the approved sources do not specify their exact route mapping. Both remain within the protected unversioned /conversations API surface; route mapping requires a separate contract decision before implementation.

The source repository contains no BFE Chat Android client implementation. Android push-receive and notification-activation behavior is traced to MC36-ANDROID-PUSH and MC36-NOTIFICATION-ACTIVATION, but Kotlin class/function signatures are intentionally not invented in this Go artifact.

Existing Issue 25 symbols are legacy implementation candidates only. Their current signatures do not establish that their current storage model, transaction semantics, or Centrifuge transport satisfy MC36-002.
Independent QA owns test creation and maintenance. This work must not create, modify, or delete tests. Independent QA and Human Approval for the resulting artifact revisions remain pending.

CLASS_CONTRACT.name: HTTPHandler
CLASS_CONTRACT.PROPOSED_SIGNATURE: func (h HTTPHandler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
CLASS_CONTRACT.RESPONSIBILITY: Validate request shape and documented size limits, delegate protected-request authentication and current authorization to their owning modules, dispatch to the responsible domain service, and map typed outcomes to HTTP responses.
CLASS_CONTRACT.PRECONDITION: Handler dependencies are non-nil; request is presented to the approved unversioned /conversations resource tree.
CLASS_CONTRACT.POSTCONDITION: Malformed, unauthenticated, disabled, or unauthorized requests cause no protected domain mutation. Failure responses disclose no protected data.
CLASS_CONTRACT.FORBIDDEN: Authenticate by trusting account UUID; decide membership locally; publish push events; infer or expose a conversation ID from wakeToken input; create undocumented route aliases.
CLASS_CONTRACT.INTENT: Translate protected HTTP requests into calls to the responsible Chat services.
CLASS_CONTRACT.INPUTS: HTTP request, response writer and injected service dependencies.
CLASS_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: One HTTP response containing the operation result or a mapped non-disclosing error.
CLASS_CONTRACT.STATE_CHANGES: No direct domain-state changes; delegated services own any authorized changes.
CLASS_CONTRACT.INVARIANTS: Malformed, oversized, unauthenticated, disabled or unauthorized requests cause no protected mutation.
CLASS_CONTRACT.NON_RESPONSIBILITIES: Does not implement session verification, membership policy, persistence, wakeToken interpretation or realtime publication.
CLASS_CONTRACT.BUSINESS_RULES: Validate request shape and documented limits before side effects; use only the approved unversioned resource tree.
CLASS_CONTRACT.TEST_PROPERTIES: Rejected requests have no protected mutation; errors reveal no conversation, message, token or endpoint secrets.
CLASS_CONTRACT.SIDE_EFFECTS: Validate and dispatch the request and write the HTTP response; no direct persistence or network publication.
CLASS_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Map validation, authentication, availability, authorization, conflict and internal errors without exposing protected values.

CLASS_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: Committed message with stable conversation ordinal and replay result.
CLASS_CONTRACT.STATE_CHANGES: Message history, conversation ordering and idempotency result.
CLASS_CONTRACT.INVARIANTS: Message and idempotency result are atomic; identical replay creates no new logical message or notification.
